$comment: This envelope is for internal outbox/domain events only (docs/architecture/events-and-resilience.md's Canonical events table, e.g. conversation.started.v1). SSE stream event types (docs/api/api-contract.md's SSE event types: run.started, response.delta, heartbeat, etc.) are a separate, lighter-weight, non-versioned category -- see $defs/SseEventType -- and are never instances of this envelope.

SseEventType.description: Dot-separated lowercase segments, no version suffix (SSE event schema versioning is carried by the event's own schemaVersion field per api-contract.md, not encoded in the type name). Matches the full SSE catalog: run.started, response.delta, response.completed, progress.updated, ui.component, tool.pending_confirmation, tool.started, tool.completed, tool.failed, run.failed, heartbeat.

type.description: Outbox/domain event type only (e.g. handoff.requested.v1). Do not use for SSE stream event names -- see the top-level $comment and $defs/SseEventType.
